integrity.proof_scope: unconditional given standard fixed-modulus Selberg-Delange theorem

scientific_limitations: Only even fixed parameters m at least four are covered.
The asymptotic is for positive second iterates, not a sharp abundance count.
Relies on the published fixed-modulus Selberg-Delange counting theorem.
Novelty is specific identification and deficiency implication, not the general counting method.
title: Exact two-step survival density for iterated Schemmel totients
